entities.name: The Early Modern Transition (1500–1800)
entities.label: Timeframe
entities.summary: The three centuries during which interconnected transformations — oceanic voyaging, the spread of printed texts, gunpowder warfare, and new philosophical currents — reshaped human societies on every continent. Global silver flows linked the Americas to Asia, print culture accelerated the circulation of ideas, and new state forms emerged from the interaction of these forces.
